user.title: Sign in to Volvo AU
user.description:
**[👉 Open Volvo sign-in in a new tab]({authorize_url})**

Sign in with your Volvo ID (email + password) and complete 2FA.

When the browser tries to open `volvooncall://auth/callback?code=…` it will fail to launch — that's expected. Copy the URL from your browser's address bar (or just the `code=…` part, or just the code itself) and paste it below.

data_description.redirect_url: Paste the full `volvooncall://…` URL, or just the code after `code=`.

init.title: Volvo AU options

data_description.registration_plate: Shown in the device name. Volvo normally supplies this itself; only fill it in to override it. Leave blank to use the plate Volvo reports.
data_description.active_interval: Default 60 (1 minute). Between 10 and 3600. Never slower than the idle interval.
data_description.live_updates: Keep a connection open to Volvo so changes arrive as they happen, as the Polestar integration does. If Volvo only ever sends one reading for a service, that service falls back to polling by itself. Look for 'live updates work' in the log to confirm.
data_description.driving_journal: Read your trips from the Volvo driving journal: adds a Last trip sensor and the get_trips and get_trips_summary services. Off by default because trips include where you drove. The journal must be turned on in the Volvo app.

init.description: How often to ask Volvo for updates. Idle is used while the car is quiet (parked, even if plugged in); Active while it is charging, in use, has something open or unlocked, or the climate is running. A command or the end of a trip always triggers fast checks for a minute or so.

get_trips.name: Get trips
get_trips.description: Returns trips from the Volvo driving journal, newest first.

start.name: From
start.description: Only trips that started after this time.

stop.name: To
stop.description: Only trips that started before this time.

include_coordinates.name: Include coordinates
include_coordinates.description: Also return the start and end latitude and longitude.

get_trips_summary.name: Get trips summary
get_trips_summary.description: Returns totals over a period: trips, distance, time, energy and electricity cost.

start.name: From
start.description: Start of the period (default 30 days ago).
